Data Engineer salary in Illinois

Based on 15 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 24, 2026), listed pay for Data Engineer jobs in Illinois is $126,500–$158,500 a year (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $140,700 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

The median listed salary midpoint is about $140,700 a year across 15 current postings. The middle 50% is $126,500–$158,500 a year.

Is this a salary survey?

No. The figures are listed pay in current job postings on Fortune Jobs AI, not a salary survey or a prediction of an offer. Listings without usable pay are excluded.

How is the range calculated?

We parse each listed pay range to its midpoint and compute the 25th and 75th percentiles. At least eight current postings with the same pay unit are required. Near-identical ranges are shown as one approximate figure.
